Repair this four-file project. Return ONLY JSON {"files":{...}} with exactly api.hia.json, client.hia.json; both complete replacement contents, no fences or explanation.
Maintain the two-file score API. saturating_sum(a:u32,b:u32)->u32 returns min(a+b,4294967295), with mathematical addition. entrypoint(a:u32,b:u32,c:u32)->u64 calls it once with original a,b and returns 7*provider_result+(c AND 7). Both current files need changes; no u32 carry may be discarded.
Each HIA file is one complete function object, preserving its name and required signature. The host atomically replaces both definitions and verifies the full Core. int.cast must use attrs {"mode":"wrap"} or checked. const has attrs.value. select args are condition,true,false; comparisons return bool. Arithmetic .wrap is modulo result width. call has attrs.function and one out per result. buffer.new takes usize length and returns buffer; borrow.mut/read return mutbuf/readbuf; buffer.store takes view,index:u-size,value:u8; buffer.load returns u8; loan.end ends a view; owner.drop consumes a buffer. End loans before moving/dropping an owner; returning buffer transfers it. No loops, recursion, extra functions, external calls or effects outside alloc/read/write/trap; max 16 blocks/128 operations per function. Only scalar, buffer, mutbuf, readbuf types.
Only these two files are editable in BOTH full and node interfaces. The other two remain unchanged.
